records.name: PhillyHikingBeauties
records.summary: A nonprofit women's hiking group in the Philadelphia area. It runs regular hikes, fitness challenges and social outings, and it has a youth program called Little Hiking Beauties.
records.what_you_do: Hike with the group, join the fitness challenges and social outings, or take part in volunteer projects.

schedule.text: Weekly hikes, usually on Saturday mornings, as posted on the events calendar. Dates and meeting places change, so check the calendar before you go.

first_step.how: Pick a Saturday hike on the events calendar, then message the group on Instagram before you go to ask how to join. Some hikes share details through an RSVP link or a group chat.
first_step.basis: The About page says beginners and all fitness levels are welcome, and the Join Us page has a Sign up now button, but the page does not spell out the sign-up steps.
first_step.what_to_expect: Most listed hikes are Saturday morning outings, usually starting between 8 and 9:30 am, on a trail in the city or the nearby suburbs. Some are easy loops of a few miles and others are longer out and back walks, so check the event listing for the pace. The site does not list a fee for hikes or dues for members. The group also runs fitness challenges and social outings.
first_visit_tips: Check the event listing for the meeting place, start time and pace before you go.
Some events share details by RSVP link or in a group chat, so ask for the chat when you sign up.
Wear shoes that can handle trail mud and bring water.
Arrive a few minutes early so you can find the group before the start time.

records.notes: The /join address returns 404; the Join Us page is at /contact and shows only a Sign up now button and an Instagram link. No dues or fees are stated anywhere on the site. The youth program is for girls in the Delaware County area, with priority to Upper Darby residents, and no ages are stated. Its program page says the facilitators have background clearances and CPR and behavioral science certifications; this is about the youth program staff, not adult hikers, so requirements.background_check is left out.
